title: Break the physics
blurb: Change a constant, change a force law, switch off exclusion. Rigorously.

steps.title: Turn up the fine-structure constant
body: Alpha is about 1 over 137 and nothing in the theory says why. Here you can move it and I will show you the level structure responding.
My badge says COUNTERFACTUAL, which is a specific promise: I altered the physics deliberately and then solved it properly under the altered rules. I am not drawing you a cartoon.

steps.title: Change the force law itself
body: Coulomb is 1 over r. Replace it with a Yukawa, a power law, or an expression you type, and I find the states of whatever you wrote with the same numerical solver.
This is why I am a radial Schrodinger solver rather than a table of hydrogen formulas. I run the counterfactual and the real atom through the same code.

steps.title: Electrons that repel but do not exclude
body: Switch off exchange and helium's electrons still repel, but they stop being identical particles. The energy moves, and the direction it moves is the whole content of the exchange term.
I am not fudging anything here. This is my same Hartree-Fock solver with one term dropped, and I label the result for what it is.

steps.title: Switch off exclusion and watch the atom collapse
body: With no occupancy cap every electron falls into the 1s. Argon becomes 1s to the eighteenth, and the periodic table stops existing.
This is the strongest counterfactual I offer and it contains the previous one: antisymmetry is what exclusion is, so I cannot switch off one and keep the other.
